headline: Five people were killed when a passenger bus travelling from Raiwind to Chiniot plunged into a drain near Fatehke in Pindi Bhattian, Hafizabad district, on Thursday, rescue officials said.

card.desc: Raiwind-Chiniot bus plunged into a drain on Thursday, rescue officials said.

caption:
Five people were killed when a passenger bus travelling from Raiwind to Chiniot plunged into a drain near Fatehke in Pindi Bhattian, Hafizabad district, early on Thursday, Arab News reports, citing rescue officials. Rescue 1122 teams used a crane to lift the bus, Dawn adds.
